chapterInfo.content:
21
Onyankopɔn kyerɛ akoma kwan
1 # Dwom 33.14 Ɔhene akoma te sɛ asutene AWURADE nsam,
baabiara a ɔpɛ no na ɔdane korɔ.
2 # Mmb 16.2; 24.12 Onipa kwan biara tene n’ani so,
nanso akoma karifoɔ ne AWURADE.
3 # 1 Sa 15.22; Yes 1.11-18; Hos 6.6 Asɛnteneneedie ne atɛntenenee
sɔ AWURADE ani sene afɔrebɔ.
4 # Yes 2.11 Ani a ɛtra ntɔn ne akoma a ɛhoran,
mekyerɛ, abɔnefoɔ kwan no deɛ, ɛyɛ bɔne.
5 # Mmb 22.29 Nsiyɛfoɔ adwene de adedodoɔ ara na ɛba,
na obiara a ɔpere ho no, ɛde kɔ ohia nko mu.
6 # Mmb 10.2 Ademudeɛ a wɔde atorɔ tɛkyerɛma anya yɛ ahuhuo a ahu korɔ;
wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ no hwehwɛ owuo.
7Abɔnefoɔ akakabensɛm de wɔn kɔ,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔpo atemmuo.
8Ɔbarima a ɛso da ne soɔ kwan kyea,
na deɛ ne ho teɛ adwuma yɛ tee.
9 # Mmb 21.19; 25.24 Ɛdan atifi kokoam tena yɛ
sene sɛ wo ne ɔbaa tɔkwapɛfoɔ bɛtena ɛdan mu.
10Ɔbɔnefoɔ kra kɔn dɔ bɔne,
ne yɔnko anim nyɛ nyam n’ani so.
11 # Mmb 19.25 Sɛ wɔtea fɛdifoɔ a, atetekwaa hunu nyansa,
na onyansafoɔ yiedie mu na ɔnya nimdeɛ.
12Ɔteneneeni gyene n’ani hwɛ abɔnefoɔ fie,
sɛdeɛ wɔka abɔnefoɔ guo sɛe wɔn.
13Deɛ ɔsi n’aso firi mmɔborɔfoɔ su ho no,
ɔno nso bɛsu afrɛ, na wɔrennye no so.
14 # 1 Sa 25.18 Kokoam adekyɛ pata abufuo,
na kokom adanmudeɛ dwodwo abufuhyeɛ.
15Ɛyɛ ɔteneneeni anigyeɛ sɛ ɔbɛdi asɛntenenee,
na ɛyɛ hu ma amumuyɛfoɔ.
16Onipa a ɔfom firi nimdeɛ kwan soɔ no
bɛtena nsamanfoɔ asafo mu.
17 # Mmb 23.21 Deɛ ɔdɔ anigyeɛ bɛdi hia,
deɛ ɔdɔ nsa ne ngo rennya adeɛ.
18 # Mmb 11.8 Ɔbɔnefoɔ bɛyɛ ɔteneneeni agyedeɛ,
na nkontomponi bɛsi teefoɔ ananmu.
19 # Mmb 21.9 Anwea pradada asase so tena yɛ
sene ɛyerɛ nwiinwiifoɔ a ne bo nnwo no nkyɛn tena.
20Ademudeɛ a ɛsom boɔ ne ngo wɔ onyansafoɔ tenabea,
na ɔkwasea deɛ, ɔsɛe no.
21Deɛ ɔdi tenenee ne adɔeɛ akyire no,
ɔbɛnya nkwa, tenenee ne animuonyam.
22 # Mmb 24.5 Onyansafoɔ foro nnɔmmarima kuro,
na ɔsum ahoɔden a wɔde wɔn ho too soɔ no twene.
23 # Mmb 13.3 Deɛ ɔkora n’ano ne ne tɛkyerɛma no,
ɔkora ne kra firi ahohia mu.
24Ɔhantanni a wahuhuro, ne din de ɔfɛdifoɔ,
ɔdi n’asɛm ahantan ntrasoɔ mu.
25 # Mmb 13.4 Ɔkwadwofoɔ akɔnnɔ ku no,
ɛfiri sɛ ne nsa nsɔ adeɛ mu.
26Obi wɔ hɔ a n’ani bere adeɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ daa nyinaa,
na ɔteneneeni deɛ, ɔma na ɔnnodo ho.
27 # Mmb 15.8 Abɔnefoɔ afɔrebɔ yɛ akyiwadeɛ,
na nkantom sɛ ɔde bɛfa adwemmɔne mu aba.
28 # Mmb 19.5, 9 Adansefoɔ atorofoɔ bɛyera,
na onipa a ɔtie asɛm, ɔkasa daa.
29Onipa bɔnefoɔ kum n’anim,
na ɔteefoɔ deɛ, ɔtaataa n’akwan.
30 # Dwom 33.10-11 Nyansa ne nhunumu ne afotuo biara nni hɔ
a ɛne AWURADE bɛdi asie.
31 # Dwom 33.17; Yes 31.1, 3 Wɔsiesie ɔpɔnkɔ ma ko da,
na nkonimdie deɛ, ɛwɔ AWURADE nsam.

Ɔhene akoma te sɛ asutene AWURADE nsam,
baabiara a ɔpɛ no na ɔdane korɔ.
Onipa kwan biara tene n’ani so,
nanso akoma karifoɔ ne AWURADE.
Asɛnteneneedie ne atɛntenenee
sɔ AWURADE ani sene afɔrebɔ.
Ani a ɛtra ntɔn ne akoma a ɛhoran,
mekyerɛ, abɔnefoɔ kwan no deɛ, ɛyɛ bɔne.
Nsiyɛfoɔ adwene de adedodoɔ ara na ɛba,
na obiara a ɔpere ho no, ɛde kɔ ohia nko mu.
Ademudeɛ a wɔde atorɔ tɛkyerɛma anya yɛ ahuhuo a ahu korɔ;
wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ no hwehwɛ owuo.
Abɔnefoɔ akakabensɛm de wɔn kɔ,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔpo atemmuo.
Ɔbarima a ɛso da ne soɔ kwan kyea,
na deɛ ne ho teɛ adwuma yɛ tee.
Ɛdan atifi kokoam tena yɛ
sene sɛ wo ne ɔbaa tɔkwapɛfoɔ bɛtena ɛdan mu.
Ɔbɔnefoɔ kra kɔn dɔ bɔne,
ne yɔnko anim nyɛ nyam n’ani so.
Sɛ wɔtea fɛdifoɔ a, atetekwaa hunu nyansa,
na onyansafoɔ yiedie mu na ɔnya nimdeɛ.
Ɔteneneeni gyene n’ani hwɛ abɔnefoɔ fie,
sɛdeɛ wɔka abɔnefoɔ guo sɛe wɔn.
Deɛ ɔsi n’aso firi mmɔborɔfoɔ su ho no,
ɔno nso bɛsu afrɛ, na wɔrennye no so.
Kokoam adekyɛ pata abufuo,
na kokom adanmudeɛ dwodwo abufuhyeɛ.
Ɛyɛ ɔteneneeni anigyeɛ sɛ ɔbɛdi asɛntenenee,
na ɛyɛ hu ma amumuyɛfoɔ.
Onipa a ɔfom firi nimdeɛ kwan soɔ no
bɛtena nsamanfoɔ asafo mu.
Deɛ ɔdɔ anigyeɛ bɛdi hia,
deɛ ɔdɔ nsa ne ngo rennya adeɛ.
Ɔbɔnefoɔ bɛyɛ ɔteneneeni agyedeɛ,
na nkontomponi bɛsi teefoɔ ananmu.
Anwea pradada asase so tena yɛ
sene ɛyerɛ nwiinwiifoɔ a ne bo nnwo no nkyɛn tena.
Ademudeɛ a ɛsom boɔ ne ngo wɔ onyansafoɔ tenabea,
na ɔkwasea deɛ, ɔsɛe no.
Deɛ ɔdi tenenee ne adɔeɛ akyire no,
ɔbɛnya nkwa, tenenee ne animuonyam.
Onyansafoɔ foro nnɔmmarima kuro,
na ɔsum ahoɔden a wɔde wɔn ho too soɔ no twene.
Deɛ ɔkora n’ano ne ne tɛkyerɛma no,
ɔkora ne kra firi ahohia mu.
Ɔhantanni a wahuhuro, ne din de ɔfɛdifoɔ,
ɔdi n’asɛm ahantan ntrasoɔ mu.
Ɔkwadwofoɔ akɔnnɔ ku no,
ɛfiri sɛ ne nsa nsɔ adeɛ mu.
Obi wɔ hɔ a n’ani bere adeɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ daa nyinaa,
na ɔteneneeni deɛ, ɔma na ɔnnodo ho.
Abɔnefoɔ afɔrebɔ yɛ akyiwadeɛ,
na nkantom sɛ ɔde bɛfa adwemmɔne mu aba.
Adansefoɔ atorofoɔ bɛyera,
na onipa a ɔtie asɛm, ɔkasa daa.
Onipa bɔnefoɔ kum n’anim,
na ɔteefoɔ deɛ, ɔtaataa n’akwan.
Nyansa ne nhunumu ne afotuo biara nni hɔ
a ɛne AWURADE bɛdi asie.
Wɔsiesie ɔpɔnkɔ ma ko da,
na nkonimdie deɛ, ɛwɔ AWURADE nsam.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
